headline: Sep 13 PM · A whole day has gone by and the instruments have added nothing. Since the AM brief the mailbox produced exactly two things — a Fiverr onboarding nudge and a Google-Workspace setup notice for the Accugene domain — and neither touches the funnel. The FA-ADS watchdog is now dark ~69 hours, the Meta→CRM spend-sync alarm has been silent ~48 hours without ever once having said "success," and today's digest has not landed yet (yesterday's arrived at 15:00Z, just after the PM brief). So the scoreboard is still frozen on the same nine numbers, the paid budget keeps draining with no interpreter reading it, and Mary Grossman's callback is now ~2 days past with still no called / referred / held written anywhere. Compliance 0/7, day 17.
